name: Enlarge Tail
text:
**Enlarge Tail**

**School** transmutation; **Level** alchemist 1, antipaladin 1, arcanist 1, druid 1, hunter 1, investigator 1, magus 1, redmantisassassin 1, sorcerer 1, summoner 1, summoner (unchained) 1, witch 1, wizard 1
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** personal
**Target** your tail
**Duration** 1 hour/level
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** no

When attacking with your tail or tail weapons, you gain 5 feet of
 reach, a +1 bonus on attack rolls, and a +2 bonus on damage rolls.
